Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — procurement routing update

Hey Karthik,

Quick update from our side — procurement has flagged the contract for an additional review (security wants one more data-retention check). Finance is willing but routing the PO will take ~10 business days. We are still actively evaluating the integrations and the team can't finish the last proof point without access to the live inferencing environment.

Is there a way to keep our sandbox/live pilot active for another 10–14 days while PO routing completes? We don't want to lose momentum — timeline from procurement: confirmatory review by 05/12 and PO issuance shortly after. I attached a note from procurement that explains the hold.

Thanks,
Maggie

> Quick update from our side — procurement has flagged the contract for an additional review...

Hi Maggie — thanks for the transparency. We can absolutely help keep the environment up while the PO finishes routing. Two quick questions to size the request: 1) approximate hold length (you mentioned ~10 business days — can you confirm a firm date?), and 2) who should we copy on any paperwork (procure@clearlinehealth.com is fine, but if there's a specific approver name that helps).

Options we can offer immediately: a short-term credit voucher to prevent token/timeouts (14 days suggested) or a temporary extension on the sandbox access tied to a one-time voucher code. If procurement can confirm PO issuance window, we can tie the extension to that date and automatically reclaim resources if the PO doesn't arrive.

I looped Kimberley from Sales Ops to expedite internal approval and record the voucher against the deal. If you can confirm the desired extension period and procurement contact, we'll send an official voucher and the usage terms.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive
